[[Image:Agmonds_End.jpg|thumb|300px|Agmond's End]]
'''Agmond's End''' is an abandoned digsite in southern central [[Badlands]], where the dwarven prospector Agmond met an unfortunate end thanks to the [[troggs]] which have infested the site. Another explorer, [[Theldurin the Lost]], camps nearby and gives out the [[Uldaman]] quests {{questlong|Neutral|40D|Solution to Doom}} and {{questlong|Neutral|41|The Lost Fragments}}.
